title: The City of Borrowed Hours
author: Barış Kısır
short_description: An archivist discovers that her missing brother is still making memories inside the machine that protects their city from the sea.
long_description: In the tidal city of Bellwether, citizens can surrender painful memories to a municipal archive. Archivist Mara Vale believes her brother died during the evacuation of the eastern wards. Then a routine deposit contains his voice, speaking yesterday. With a salvage captain and a disgraced registry clerk, Mara follows a trail of altered consent forms into the living infrastructure beneath the city. There she discovers how Bellwether bought its safety, what she herself agreed to forget, and why rescuing her brother may require a city to learn how to live without borrowed minds.
